name: Taste Their Fear / Evolved Reaper Claws

values.meaning: Evolved: cooldown reduction against Isolated targets
values.quote: If the target is {{as|Isolated|buzzword}}, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 45%.

mechanics.claim: Isolation for Taste Their Fear is checked at the end of cast, meaning the target must still be Isolated when the ability lands for the bonus damage to apply.
mechanics.quote: For ''Taste Their Fear'', the end of cast.{{bug}} This means that if the target is no longer {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} when the ability hits them, ''Taste Their Fear'' will not apply the respective bonuses.

mechanics.claim: Isolated Reaper Claws (evolved) checks Isolation at the start of cast instead of the end.
mechanics.quote: For ''{{ai|Evolved Reaper Claws|Kha'Zix}}'', the start of cast.

mechanics.claim: An enemy is considered Isolated if not near an ally, defined as champions, pets, minions and outer turrets (monsters count as allies to other monsters); this determines whether the increased damage tier applies.
mechanics.quote: '''Kha'Zix''' considers any enemy unit to be {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} if they are not nearby to one of their allies.
